description: Hand-written synthetic incidents. kind: normal = clean failure chain; trap = earlier noise from a service the symptom does not depend on (topology-invalid); red_herring = earlier noise from a service the symptom does depend on (topology-valid). Log rows are [time UTC, service, level, message].

rb-db-failover.content: Runbook: db-primary connection failures. If services report connection refused to db-primary:5432, check postgres with systemctl status postgresql on db-primary. If the primary is down, promote db-replica-1 via ops-console and restart the payments and orders connection pools.

rb-db-disk.content: Runbook: db-primary disk full. When postgres logs No space left on device, remove old WAL archives with pg_archivecleanup. Then expand the data volume; writes resume once usage is below 85%.

rb-app-disk.content: Runbook: application disk full. If a service such as payments logs No space left on device for its local volume, delete files older than 30 days under /data. Then expand the volume and alert the service owner.

rb-auth-latency.content: Runbook: auth-service slow token validation. Gateway 504s on login usually mean auth-service workers are saturated or paused. Restart the stuck auth-service pods. Scale auth-service to 4 replicas and check heap usage.

rb-redis-oom.content: Runbook: redis-cache out of memory. OOM command not allowed means redis-cache reached maxmemory. Set the eviction policy to allkeys-lru and raise maxmemory. Flush session keys only if on-call approves.

rb-deploy-rollback.content: Runbook: bad deployment. If errors start right after a deploy event, roll back with deployctl rollback for the affected service. Open an incident ticket and tag the release owner.

rb-rate-limit.content: Runbook: auth-service token quota (HTTP 429). When auth-service returns 429 Too Many Requests, the per-client token quota is exhausted. Raise rate_limit.per_client in the auth-service config. Ask the calling team to batch token checks.

rb-gateway-ratelimit.content: Runbook: gateway global rate limit. If gateway rejects many requests with 429, check rate_limit.global in the gateway config; the production value is 500rps. Revert a bad config with configctl rollback gateway.

doc-node-sizing.content: Guide: inventory node sizing. Inventory pods need 2 vCPU and 4 GiB of memory. Scale horizontally above 300 requests per second.

doc-notifications.content: Thread: notifications email retries. notifications retries SMTP delivery 5 times with exponential backoff. Failed emails go to the dead-letter queue.

doc-gateway-tls.content: Guide: gateway TLS certificates. gateway certificates renew automatically 30 days before expiry via cert-manager. Manual renewal is only needed if cert-manager is down.
